about: Marginalia's 'How to return a book' video, written for the course: six slides drawn by the lab and a narration spoken by one Piper voice. Slide 3 and slide 6 show things the narration does not say, and a 0.4-second card between slides 4 and 5 is said by nobody at all. Both are on purpose, for lessons 4 and 14.

slides.title: Returning a book to Marginalia
lines: Four steps and a free label
slides.say: Here is how to return a book you bought from Marginalia. It takes four steps, and the label is free.

slides.title: 1. Open the order
lines: Find the order the book came in
slides.say: First, sign in and open the order the book came in. You will find it under Account, then Orders.

slides.title: 2. Choose a reason
slides.say: Second, press Return this item and choose a reason from the list.

slides.title: 3. Print the label
lines: The prepaid label arrives by e-mail
Tape it over the old address
slides.say: Third, print the prepaid label we send you by e-mail, and tape it over the old address.

slides.title: Code: RETURN30
lines: Quote it if you call us

slides.title: 4. Drop it off
slides.say: Fourth, drop the parcel at any post office, and keep the receipt until your refund arrives.

slides.title: Refunds
lines: The label is valid for 7 days
slides.say: Refunds go back to the card you paid with. A damaged book is refunded in full, shipping included.
